workspace.b_kdiff_snapshot: device copy of nlev*ncells f32 cotangent before reverse, disjoint
workspace.failure_records: 9 int32 source flags, zero before launch and check after; flag index is source_id minus one
workspace.reverse_topology: cells_on_edge from the same validated fixed mesh
workspace.branch_record: uint32[2][2], zero before each launch; deterministic integer arm counts in spec branch order

accumulation: One gather owner per edge-level; strain_scale and ceiling use first-block fixed-order f64 partial reductions; integer atomics only for deterministic failure flags and branch counts.
cotangent_accumulation: Duplicate float32 input contributions are gathered in a deterministic float64 register and rounded once on output; scalar reductions use a fixed block/thread order.
shape_contract: Symbolic dimensions are resolved from the launch and fixed mesh; ninterfaces is the captured allocation extent and is at least nlev.

seed_copy_contract: The saved snapshot is initialized from the incoming output cotangent before the reverse launch; it is disjoint from the consumed output buffer.
cotangent_binding_contract: Incoming output cotangents use the output-seed allocation and are consumed by the reverse entry; outgoing input cotangents use a separate accumulation allocation. Saved seed-copy bindings snapshot the incoming seed before the entry.
